guard.mockNotice: Prototype: the role check is simulated. Real authentication is added later.
guard.deniedBody: This area is only available to platform super admins.

common.utcNote: All times are shown in UTC.
common.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the decision. This is recorded in the audit log.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: All shops on the platform. Filter by status and open a shop to manage it.

orgDetail.actionsActive: Suspending a shop makes its landing page return 404, switches its dashboard to read-only with a banner and stops new bookings. Existing bookings are kept.
orgDetail.actionsSuspended: This shop is suspended. Reactivating restores its landing page, dashboard access and online bookings.
orgDetail.actionsOther: Suspend and reactivate are only available for shops in the Active or Suspended state.
orgDetail.suspendBody: The landing page will return 404 and new bookings will be blocked. Provide a reason for the audit log.
orgDetail.reactivateBody: The landing page and bookings become available again. Provide a reason for the audit log.
orgDetail.actionFailed: The status of the shop could not be changed.

reports.title: Report management
reports.description: Reports sent by visitors with "Report this site" on a shop's landing page. Review each one, then resolve it or dismiss it.
reports.resolveBody: Mark the report as handled. Add an optional note for the audit log.
reports.dismissBody: Mark the report as not actionable. Add an optional note for the audit log.
reports.loadError: The reports could not be loaded.
reports.conflict: This report was already handled by someone else. The list was refreshed.
reports.saveError: The report could not be updated. Please try again.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: The trace of what the users do on the platform: customers, shop owners, guests and system admins. Use it to find what happened when a user asks for support.
audit.searchEmailPlaceholder: Who did it, or who it was done to
audit.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.
audit.utcNote: All times are shown in UTC. A line never holds a password, a token or a link with a secret.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Close or open any session of this shop that has not ended. The limits of the shop owner (3 re-schedules, 4 closes) do not apply to you, and your changes are not counted in them.
sessions.closeBody: The shop owner will see this in the history of the session. Please give the reason.
sessions.failed: The session could not be changed.

fees.formula: Each shop has its own rates. Profit of this shop = total income − maintenance fee − service fee.
fees.maintenanceHint: Taken from every booking: a percentage of what the booking paid.
fees.serviceHint: A percentage of the income of the shop.
fees.saved: Fees saved. The Income page of this shop uses the new rates.
fees.saveFailed: The fees could not be saved.

errors.invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most 2 decimals.
errors.totalTooHigh: The two fees together cannot be more than 100%.

dir.error: The list could not be loaded.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account on the platform: shop owners and customers. Activate or deactivate an account, edit it, or reset its password.
users.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, phone, id or shop
users.failed: The action could not be done.
users.deactivateBody: The person cannot log in or use their area until the account is activated again.
users.activateBody: The person can log in again with their password.
users.resetBody: The account is deactivated and an email with a temporary password and a link goes to {email}. The person opens the link, enters the temporary password and chooses a new one; then the account is active again.
users.resetDone: The account is deactivated and the email was sent to {email}.
users.editBody: Change the name and the phone of {email}.

shops.title: Shops
shops.description: Every shop on the platform. Activate or deactivate a shop and choose whether its workshops are listed for guests.
shops.failed: The action could not be done.
shops.hiddenDone: {name} is no longer listed for guests.
shops.deactivateBody: The landing page and the bookings of the shop stop working. Please give the reason; it is recorded in the audit log.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.searchPlaceholder: Workshop, shop, booking code, email or user id
bookings.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: The emails that booked workshops, for the whole platform.
customers.searchPlaceholder: Email, name or the shop where they booked

sessionsAll.title: Sessions
sessionsAll.description: The sessions of every shop. Close a session or open it again without the limits of the shop owner: a session closed more than 3 times can be opened again here.
sessionsAll.searchPlaceholder: Code, workshop, day (YYYY-MM-DD), status, note or shop
sessionsAll.closeBody: The shop owner sees this in the history of the session and the guests are told. Please give the reason.
sessionsAll.failed: The session could not be changed.

landing.title: Landing pages
landing.description: Edit the landing page of a shop with the page builder, in admin mode. Your changes are recorded in the audit log as made by an administrator.
landing.failed: The editor could not be opened.

income.title: Income
income.description: The income of the platform (admin) is the maintenance fee + the service fee charged on the bookings of the shops. Profit of the platform = income of the admin - affiliate fee - referral bonus.
income.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.
income.formula: Profit = income of the admin - affiliate fee - referral bonus
income.note: The income of the admin is the maintenance fee plus the service fee, each a percentage of the ORIGINAL price of the booking (before vouchers) at the rates of each shop (Config fees). The affiliate fee is paid only for bookings that came through an affiliate link. The referral bonus is paid once for each invited friend, on the first paid booking of the friend. Both are also a percentage of the original price. Shop revenue is what the shops received from the guests.

feesAll.title: Config fees
feesAll.description: The maintenance fee, the service fee, the affiliate fee and the referral bonus, in percent of the original price of a booking. Set them for one shop, or apply the same rates to every shop at once.
feesAll.bulkIntro: The four rates below replace the rates of every shop.
feesAll.invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 (at most 2 decimals).
feesAll.totalTooHigh: The maintenance and the service fee together cannot be more than 100%.
feesAll.defaults: Until set, a shop uses {m}% maintenance, {s}% service, {r}% affiliate and {b}% referral bonus, all of the original price.
feesAll.failed: The fees could not be saved.
feesAll.bulkDone: The rates were applied to {n} shops.
feesAll.confirmTitle: Apply these rates to all shops?
feesAll.confirmBody: Maintenance {m}%, service {s}%, affiliate {r}%, referral bonus {b}% for {n} shops. The rates they have now are replaced.

affiliate.title: Affiliate
affiliate.description: The affiliate links. A customer with an account picks a workshop and shares its link; a paid booking that comes through it earns them an affiliate fee = affiliate fee of the shop x the original price of the booking.
affiliate.searchPlaceholder: Email of the person, code, workshop or shop
affiliate.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.
affiliate.disableBody: The link stops leading to a booking and nothing new is attributed to it. The customer sees it as deactivated. What it earned before stays. A reason is needed.
affiliate.failed: The link could not be changed.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: The referral program: a customer invites friends to register a customer account with their one link. When a friend pays their first booking after registering, the customer earns the referral bonus, once for each friend.
referrals.searchPlaceholder: Email of the customer, code, or a friend
referrals.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.
referrals.noFriends: No friend has registered through this link yet.
referrals.rule: Referral bonus = the referral bonus rate of the shop (Config fees) x the original price of the first paid booking the friend made after registering. It is earned once for each friend and is paid by the platform: it is taken off the profit of the platform.
referrals.disableTitle: Switch off the invite link of {email}?
referrals.disableBody: A friend who registers with this link is no longer counted. The friends and the bonuses earned before stay. A reason is needed.
referrals.disabledDone: The invite link of {email} is off.
referrals.enabledDone: The invite link of {email} is on again.
referrals.failed: The invite link could not be changed.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.description: The withdrawals customers asked for from their Affiliate and Referrals earnings, one invoice each. Pay a pending invoice once the money was sent, or reject it with a reason.
withdrawals.searchPlaceholder: Invoice number, email or name of the customer
withdrawals.dateOrder: The first day is after the last day.
withdrawals.pendingCount: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} to process
withdrawals.rejectedHint: Their amount went back to the customers
withdrawals.payBody: Confirm that {amount} was sent to {email}. An invoice is processed once.
withdrawals.rejectBody: The amount of {amount} goes back to what the customer can withdraw. Please give the reason; the customer sees it.
withdrawals.failed: The invoice could not be processed.
withdrawals.rule: The affiliate fees and the referral bonuses are already taken off the profit of the platform when they are earned (Income), so paying an invoice does not change the profit.

supportContact.title: Support contact
supportContact.description: How shop owners and customers reach the platform team when they need help.
supportContact.boundary: These are the contacts of the platform, not of a shop. They show in the shop owner area and in the customer menu, and never on a landing page.
supportContact.invalidNumber: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits (digits, spaces, + ( ) . - only).
supportContact.saved: Support contact saved. Shop owners and customers now see it.
supportContact.failed: The support contact could not be saved.
supportContact.loadFailed: The support contact could not be loaded.
supportContact.previewIntro: The channels below are shown, in this order.
supportContact.previewEmpty: No channel is set: the Need help? block is hidden.

hint.whatsapp: Number with the country code. Leave empty to hide this channel.
hint.phone: Number people can call. Leave empty to hide this channel.
hint.zalo: Zalo phone number. Leave empty to hide this channel.
hint.email: Leave empty to hide this channel.

editAs.text: You are editing {shop} as a system administrator. Your changes are recorded in the audit log as made by an administrator.

shopEdit.title: Edit {name}
shopEdit.description: Changes are recorded in the audit log as made by an administrator. The slug of a shop never changes.
shopEdit.name: Shop name
shopEdit.slugHint: Part of the addresses of the shop: it cannot be changed, not even by an administrator.
shopEdit.regionalWarning: Changing the timezone or currency does not convert existing bookings, sessions or prices. Existing data keeps its original values.
shopEdit.customDomainHint: The landing page is served at this domain instead of {slug}.{platform domain}; the address of the platform keeps working. Leave empty to remove it.
shopEdit.failed: The shop could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.defaultMustBeEnabled: The default language must be enabled.
errors.platform: This domain belongs to the platform. Enter the own domain of the shop.
errors.taken: Another shop already uses this domain.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Values for the whole platform. A change applies at once and is recorded in the audit log.
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.failed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.withdrawalDesc: The smallest and the largest amount a customer can ask to withdraw at once (Affiliate and Referrals).
settings.resetDesc: How long the link that an administrator sends for a password reset works, counted from the moment it is sent.
settings.contactDesc: How many messages one visitor can send with the Contact form of the public site.
settings.contactHint: 5 an hour by default. More than that is refused until the hour is over.

errors.invalid: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
errors.order: The largest withdrawal cannot be less than the smallest.
errors.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
